blocks.zh: 熱原試驗（兔法）— 完整章節教學版
blocks.en: Pyrogen Test (Rabbit) - Complete Chapter Tutorial

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解兔熱原試驗（Rabbit Pyrogen Test, RPT）的設計原理：透過監測兔子注射後的體溫上升來評估注射劑中的熱原含量
blocks.en: Understand the design principle of the Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT): evaluating the pyrogen content of an injectable by monitoring the rise in rabbit body temperature after injection

blocks.zh: 掌握試驗器材除熱原處理、溫度記錄設備校正、試驗動物條件等前置要求
blocks.en: Master the prerequisites: depyrogenation of test apparatus, calibration of temperature-recording equipment, and test animal conditions

blocks.zh: 了解初始 3 隻兔子試驗 → 追加 5 隻重測的階段式判定邏輯（個體 ≥0.5°C、總和 ≤3.3°C）
blocks.en: Understand the staged decision logic: initial test with 3 rabbits, then retest with 5 additional rabbits (individual rise ≥0.5°C, sum of rises ≤3.3°C)

blocks.zh: 認識放射性藥品的特殊劑量計算規則
blocks.en: Become familiar with the special dose calculation rules for radioactive pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 理解 USP⟨151⟩RPT 與 USP⟨85⟩BET 的歷史關係，以及產業從活體試驗轉向體外試驗的趨勢
blocks.en: Understand the historical relationship between USP⟨151⟩ RPT and USP⟨85⟩ BET, and the industry shift from in vivo to in vitro testing

blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析
blocks.en: Core Concepts

blocks.zh: Pyrogen（熱原）：任何注射進人體後能引起發燒反應（febrile reaction）的物質。最常見的是革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁上的內毒素（endotoxin），但也包括其他非內毒素熱原（non-endotoxin pyrogens, NEP），如脂壁酸（lipoteichoic acid）、真菌成分、病毒蛋白等。
blocks.en: Pyrogen: Any substance that causes a febrile reaction when injected into the human body. The most common is endotoxin from the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria, but pyrogens also include non-endotoxin pyrogens (NEP) such as lipoteichoic acid, fungal components, and viral proteins.

blocks.zh: Rabbit Pyrogen Test（兔熱原試驗, RPT）：USP⟨151⟩定義的經典活體試驗方法。原理很直覺 — 把待測樣品注射到兔子耳靜脈，如果含有熱原，兔子會發燒。測量體溫升高幅度來判定是否合格。
blocks.en: Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT): The classic in vivo method defined in USP⟨151⟩. The principle is intuitive: the test sample is injected into the marginal ear vein of rabbits, and if it contains pyrogens, the rabbits develop a fever. The size of the temperature rise determines whether the sample passes.

blocks.zh: 關鍵限制條件：
blocks.en: Key limiting conditions:

blocks.zh: 劑量上限 — 10 mL/kg 體重，10 分鐘內完成注射
blocks.en: Dose limit - 10 mL/kg of body weight, with the injection completed within 10 minutes

blocks.zh: 可替代性 — 原文明確允許使用經驗證的體外試驗（如 BET）替代
blocks.en: Substitutability - The text expressly allows a validated in vitro test (such as BET) to be used instead

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 「食物試毒官」的概念：
blocks.en: The "food taster" concept:

blocks.zh: 古代皇帝吃飯前，會有人先試吃以確認食物安全。兔熱原試驗的邏輯完全一樣 — 在藥品注射到病人之前，先讓兔子「試注射」。如果兔子沒有發燒，就認為藥品中熱原含量在可接受範圍內。
blocks.en: In ancient times, someone would taste the emperor's food first to confirm it was safe. The logic of the rabbit pyrogen test is exactly the same: before the drug is injected into a patient, a rabbit gets a "trial injection" first. If the rabbit does not develop a fever, the pyrogen content of the drug is considered acceptable.

blocks.zh: 當然，現代藥學已經發展出更精密的化學檢測方法（BET），就像現代食品安全已經從「試吃」進化到化學分析一樣。但這個「試毒官」方法在某些特殊情況下仍然無法被完全取代。
blocks.en: Of course, modern pharmaceutical science has developed more refined chemical test methods (BET), just as modern food safety has evolved from "taste testing" to chemical analysis. But this "food taster" method still cannot be fully replaced in certain special situations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: RPT 檢測的不只是內毒素：這是 RPT 相對於 BET 最重要的優勢。BET（Bacterial Endotoxin Test, USP⟨85⟩）只能檢測革蘭氏陰性菌的脂多醣內毒素。但 RPT 是生物學反應 — 兔子的免疫系統會對所有種類的熱原產生發燒反應，包括非內毒素熱原。
blocks.en: RPT detects more than endotoxin: This is the most important advantage of RPT over BET. BET (Bacterial Endotoxin Test, USP⟨85⟩) can only detect lipopolysaccharide endotoxin from Gram-negative bacteria. RPT, however, is a biological response: the rabbit's immune system produces a fever response to all kinds of pyrogens, including non-endotoxin pyrogens.

blocks.zh: FDA 立場（2012 Guidance）：FDA 明確表示，經過適當驗證的 BET 或體外熱原試驗可以替代 RPT。腳註 1 引用的就是這份 FDA 指引。
blocks.en: FDA position (2012 Guidance): FDA states clearly that a properly validated BET or in vitro pyrogen test may replace RPT. Footnote 1 cites this FDA guidance.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品已知會干擾 LAL 試劑（例如某些抗凝血劑），為什麼 RPT 可能是唯一可用的熱原檢測方法？
blocks.en: If a product is known to interfere with LAL reagent (for example, certain anticoagulants), why might RPT be the only usable pyrogen test?

blocks.zh: 原文說 RPT 用於「能被試驗兔耐受」的產品。如果你的產品對兔子有毒性，你該怎麼辦？
blocks.en: The text says RPT is used for products that "can be tolerated by the test rabbits". What should you do if your product is toxic to rabbits?

blocks.zh: Apparatus and Diluents — 器材與稀釋液
blocks.en: Apparatus and Diluents

blocks.zh: Depyrogenation（除熱原處理）：250°C × 30 分鐘是製藥業最經典的乾熱除熱原條件。內毒素是非常穩定的分子 — 一般的滅菌溫度（121°C 高壓蒸汽滅菌）無法有效破壞它。需要極高的乾熱溫度才能使內毒素碳化分解。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: 250°C × 30 minutes is the classic dry-heat depyrogenation condition in the pharmaceutical industry. Endotoxin is a very stable molecule, and ordinary sterilization temperatures (121°C autoclaving) cannot destroy it effectively. Very high dry-heat temperatures are needed to carbonize and break down the endotoxin.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要做控制試驗（Control Pyrogen Tests）？
blocks.en: Why run control pyrogen tests?

blocks.zh: 即使稀釋液標示為「無熱原」，長期儲存或操作過程中仍可能引入污染
blocks.en: Even if a diluent is labeled "pyrogen-free", contamination can still be introduced during long-term storage or handling

blocks.zh: 定期對沖洗液做陽性/陰性對照，確保試驗系統本身不會產生假陽性或假陰性
blocks.en: Run positive/negative controls on rinse solutions periodically to ensure that the test system itself does not generate false positives or false negatives

blocks.zh: 烤箱烤盤的清潔：
blocks.en: Cleaning of oven trays:

blocks.zh: 想像你要做一道料理來測試某種食材是否有異味。如果你的鍋子本身就殘留上一道菜的味道，你就無法準確判斷食材。所以你必須把鍋子徹底洗淨（甚至用高溫烤過），才能開始測試。250°C/30 分鐘就是「把所有殘留的味道（熱原）徹底烤掉」。
blocks.en: Imagine you are cooking a dish to test whether an ingredient has an off smell. If your pot still holds the smell of the previous dish, you cannot judge the ingredient accurately. So you must wash the pot thoroughly (even bake it at high temperature) before you start testing. 250°C/30 minutes is "baking away all the residual smell (pyrogen)".

blocks.zh: 為什麼除熱原溫度是 250°C 而不是滅菌常用的 121°C？從內毒素的分子結構（脂多醣，LPS）來思考。
blocks.en: Why is the depyrogenation temperature 250°C rather than the 121°C commonly used for sterilization? Think about it from the molecular structure of endotoxin (lipopolysaccharide, LPS).

blocks.zh: 原文說可以用「any other suitable method」除熱原。除了乾熱，你知道還有哪些方法可以破壞內毒素？（提示：化學法、輻射法）
blocks.en: The text says depyrogenation may be done by "any other suitable method". Besides dry heat, what other methods do you know that can destroy endotoxin? (Hint: chemical and radiation methods.)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：在你的無菌充填工廠中，除熱原處理不只用於 RPT 器材。所有直接接觸注射劑的玻璃容器（西林瓶 vials）、膠塞（stoppers）和注射針頭在進入充填線前都需要經過除熱原處理。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: In your aseptic filling facility, depyrogenation is not used only for RPT apparatus. All glass containers (vials), stoppers, and injection needles that come into direct contact with the injectable must be depyrogenated before entering the filling line.

blocks.zh: 常見條件：
blocks.en: Common conditions:

blocks.zh: Temperature Recording — 溫度記錄
blocks.en: Temperature Recording

blocks.zh: 精度要求 ±0.1°C：這個精度要求是整個試驗判定邏輯的基礎。因為合格/不合格的門檻是 0.5°C 的體溫上升 — 如果你的溫度計誤差就有 ±0.3°C，那整個試驗結果就毫無意義。
blocks.en: Accuracy requirement of ±0.1°C: This accuracy requirement underpins the decision logic of the whole test. Because the pass/fail threshold is a body temperature rise of 0.5°C, a thermometer with an error of ±0.3°C would make the test result meaningless.

blocks.zh: 直腸測溫深度 ≥7.5 cm：確保探針深入到核心體溫區域，避免受環境溫度影響的淺層組織干擾讀數。
blocks.en: Rectal insertion depth ≥7.5 cm: This ensures the probe reaches the core body temperature zone and avoids readings disturbed by shallow tissue affected by ambient temperature.

blocks.zh: 5 分鐘內達到最大讀數：這確保了溫度探針的響應時間足夠快，不會因為儀器反應慢而遺漏短暫的溫度高峰。
blocks.en: Maximum reading reached within 5 minutes: This ensures the temperature probe responds quickly enough that a slow instrument does not miss a brief temperature peak.

blocks.zh: 就像醫院量體溫：你去醫院時，護士會用耳溫槍或口溫計量你的核心體溫。RPT 的邏輯完全相同，只是兔子用的是直腸溫度（更準確）。想像一下，如果護士的溫度計有 1°C 的誤差，37.5°C 和 38.5°C 就無法區分 — 你根本不知道病人有沒有發燒。RPT 也是一樣的道理。
blocks.en: Just like taking a temperature at the hospital: When you visit a hospital, the nurse uses an ear thermometer or an oral thermometer to measure your core body temperature. The logic of RPT is exactly the same, except that rabbits are measured rectally (which is more accurate). Imagine that the nurse's thermometer had an error of 1°C: 37.5°C and 38.5°C could not be told apart, and you would have no idea whether the patient had a fever. The same reasoning applies to RPT.

blocks.zh: 校正是 GMP 基本功：溫度探針的 ±0.1°C 精度要求意味著你必須有完善的校正程序（Calibration SOP），包括：
blocks.en: Calibration is a GMP basic: The ±0.1°C accuracy requirement for temperature probes means you must have a sound calibration procedure (Calibration SOP), including:

blocks.zh: 使用 NIST 可追溯的標準溫度計進行校正
blocks.en: Calibration against NIST-traceable reference thermometers

blocks.zh: 定義校正週期（通常每 6-12 個月）
blocks.en: A defined calibration interval (typically every 6-12 months)

blocks.zh: 校正偏差的接受標準（OOS 調查觸發點）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria for calibration deviation (the OOS investigation trigger)

blocks.zh: 使用中的查核（in-use verification）— 每次試驗前確認讀數合理
blocks.en: In-use verification: confirming before each test that the readings are reasonable

blocks.zh: 如果試驗過程中發現某支溫度探針的校正已過期，這批試驗數據還能使用嗎？你的偏差調查會如何進行？
blocks.en: If a temperature probe is found to be out of calibration during a test, can the data from that test still be used? How would your deviation investigation proceed?

blocks.zh: Test Animals — 試驗動物
blocks.en: Test Animals

blocks.zh: Sham Test（模擬試驗）：在正式使用兔子之前，先做一次「假的」完整程序 — 包括固定、量體溫、模擬注射等所有步驟，但不實際注射任何東西。目的是讓兔子習慣整個程序，避免因為緊張、恐懼而產生應激性體溫上升（stress-induced hyperthermia）。
blocks.en: Sham test: Before the rabbits are used in a real test, run one complete "dummy" procedure, including restraint, temperature measurement, and simulated injection, but without injecting anything. The purpose is to let the rabbits become used to the whole procedure and avoid stress-induced hyperthermia caused by nervousness or fear.

blocks.zh: 三大使用限制：
blocks.en: Three major restrictions on use:

blocks.zh: 48 小時間隔 — 確保兔子從上一次試驗完全恢復
blocks.en: 48-hour interval - ensures the rabbit has fully recovered from the previous test

blocks.zh: 2 週禁用期 — 如果兔子體溫升高 ≥0.6°C，可能已經被致敏（sensitized），需要更長的恢復期
blocks.en: 2-week exclusion period - if a rabbit's temperature rises by ≥0.6°C, it may have become sensitized and needs a longer recovery period

blocks.zh: 陽性樣品後禁用 — 接觸過熱原陽性樣品的兔子可能產生免疫記憶，影響後續判定
blocks.en: Exclusion after a positive sample - a rabbit that has received a pyrogen-positive sample may develop immune memory that affects later determinations

blocks.zh: 運動員的體能管理：
blocks.en: An athlete's fitness management:

blocks.zh: 試驗兔就像專業運動員 — 每次「比賽」（試驗）之間需要足夠的休息時間（48 小時）。如果上次「受傷」了（體溫大幅上升），就需要更長的恢復期（2 週）。而且比賽前要先做「暖身」（sham test），讓選手適應場地和流程，避免正式比賽時因為緊張而表現異常。
blocks.en: Test rabbits are like professional athletes: they need enough rest (48 hours) between "matches" (tests). If they were "injured" last time (a large temperature rise), they need a longer recovery period (2 weeks). And before the match they do a "warm-up" (the sham test) so the athlete gets used to the venue and routine and does not perform abnormally from nervousness on match day.

blocks.zh: 動物福利的轉折點：這些嚴格的動物管理要求恰恰反映了 RPT 的一個根本問題 — 它依賴活體動物。在 3Rs 原則（Replacement 替代、Reduction 減少、Refinement 改善）的推動下，全球法規趨勢都在鼓勵從 RPT 轉向體外方法（BET 或 MAT）。
blocks.en: The turning point for animal welfare: These strict animal management requirements reflect a fundamental problem of RPT: it depends on live animals. Driven by the 3Rs principles (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement), regulatory trends worldwide encourage a move from RPT to in vitro methods (BET or MAT).

blocks.zh: 歐洲藥典的里程碑：2010 年起，European Pharmacopoeia 已刪除 RPT，改用 BET 和 Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)。USP 保留⟨151⟩但在腳註中明確指向 BET 替代。
blocks.en: A milestone for the European Pharmacopoeia: Starting in 2010, the European Pharmacopoeia deleted RPT in favor of BET and the Monocyte Activation Test (MAT). USP retains ⟨151⟩ but points explicitly to BET as a substitute in its footnote.

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 sham test？如果跳過這個步驟，可能會對試驗結果產生什麼影響？（提示：想想兔子第一次被固定和量體溫時的心理壓力。）
blocks.en: Why is a sham test needed? If this step is skipped, what effect might it have on the test results? (Hint: think about the psychological stress of a rabbit being restrained and having its temperature taken for the first time.)

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 是否還在使用 RPT？如果是，你需要維持多大的兔群（colony）才能滿足日常放行測試的需求？（考慮 48 小時間隔和 2 週禁用期的限制。）
blocks.en: Does your CDMO still use RPT? If so, how large a rabbit colony would you need to maintain to meet routine release testing demand? (Consider the 48-hour interval and the 2-week exclusion period.)

blocks.zh: Procedure — 試驗程序
blocks.en: Procedure

blocks.zh: 科學實驗的「公平起跑線」：
blocks.en: A "fair starting line" for a scientific experiment:

blocks.zh: 想像一場賽跑比賽。你需要確保所有選手（兔子）在同一個起跑線上（基線體溫差 ≤1°C），沒有人帶傷上場（體溫 ≤39.8°C），而且比賽前都沒有吃大餐（禁食）。注射的樣品溫度也要剛好是體溫（37°C），就像比賽時的跑道溫度不能太熱或太冷。然後你在固定的時間點（每 30 分鐘）拍下選手的成績（體溫讀數）。
blocks.en: Imagine a race. You need to make sure that all the runners (rabbits) are on the same starting line (baseline temperatures within 1°C of each other), that nobody starts injured (temperature ≤39.8°C), and that nobody ate a big meal before the race (food withheld). The injected sample must also be at body temperature (37°C), just as the track temperature must be neither too hot nor too cold. Then you record the runners' results (temperature readings) at fixed time points (every 30 minutes).

blocks.zh: 為什麼是耳靜脈？兔子的耳朵血管表淺且清晰可見，是最容易進行靜脈注射的部位。這也是為什麼 RPT 專門使用兔子而非其他動物的原因之一。
blocks.en: Why the ear vein? The blood vessels in a rabbit's ear are superficial and clearly visible, making it the easiest site for intravenous injection. This is one of the reasons RPT uses rabbits rather than other animals.

blocks.zh: 樣品溫度 37 ± 2°C 的重要性：如果注射冰冷的溶液（例如 4°C），兔子可能因為冷刺激而產生體溫反應，造成假陽性。反之，過熱的溶液也可能直接引起局部組織反應。
blocks.en: Why a sample temperature of 37 ± 2°C matters: If an ice-cold solution (for example, 4°C) is injected, the rabbit may show a temperature response to the cold stimulus, causing a false positive. Conversely, an overly hot solution may also cause a direct local tissue reaction.

blocks.zh: CDMO 器材測試：原文特別提到，對於醫療器材或注射組件，要用接觸表面的「沖洗液」來做試驗。這在 CDMO 做容器密封系統（Container Closure System）驗證時特別重要。
blocks.en: CDMO device testing: The text specifically mentions that for medical devices or injection components, the test is run on a "rinse solution" of the contact surfaces. This is particularly important when a CDMO validates a Container Closure System.

blocks.zh: 為什麼同組兔子的基線體溫差要 ≤1°C？如果一隻兔子基線 38.0°C，另一隻 39.5°C，會對結果判定造成什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why must the baseline temperatures of rabbits in the same group differ by ≤1°C? If one rabbit has a baseline of 38.0°C and another 39.5°C, what problem would this cause for the interpretation of results?

blocks.zh: 注射後 1-3 小時監測，每 30 分鐘記錄一次 — 這意味著你會得到幾個溫度讀數？為什麼不從注射後立即開始記錄？
blocks.en: Temperature is monitored for 1-3 hours after injection, recorded every 30 minutes. How many temperature readings does this give you? Why not start recording immediately after injection?

blocks.zh: Control Temperature（對照體溫）：注射前 30 分鐘內測量的基線體溫。所有後續的「體溫上升」都是相對於這個基線計算的。這是整個試驗最關鍵的數據點。
blocks.en: Control Temperature: The baseline temperature measured within the 30 minutes before injection. All later "temperature rises" are calculated relative to this baseline. It is the most critical data point in the whole test.

blocks.zh: 程序要點整理：
blocks.en: Procedure summary:

blocks.zh: Test Interpretation and Continuation — 結果判定與續試
blocks.en: Test Interpretation and Continuation

blocks.zh: 品質管理的「抽樣檢驗」邏輯：
blocks.en: The "acceptance sampling" logic of quality control:

blocks.zh: 就像工廠品管部門的抽樣計畫：先抽 3 個樣品快速檢查。如果全部合格，整批放行。如果有任何一個可疑，擴大抽樣到 8 個。如果 8 個中不良品不超過 3 個，而且整體嚴重程度（總和）在可接受範圍內，仍然可以放行。這就是統計學上的「雙次抽樣檢驗計畫」（Double Sampling Plan）。
blocks.en: It is like a factory QC sampling plan: first take 3 samples for a quick check. If all pass, the whole lot is released. If any one is questionable, expand the sampling to 8. If no more than 3 of the 8 are defective and the overall severity (the sum) is within an acceptable range, the lot can still be released. This is the statistical "Double Sampling Plan".

blocks.zh: Stage 2 的雙重條件：第二階段必須同時滿足兩個條件才能通過：
blocks.en: The dual conditions of Stage 2: The second stage must satisfy both of the following conditions to pass:

blocks.zh: ≤3 隻兔子個體升溫 ≥0.5°C（個體標準）
blocks.en: No more than 3 rabbits with an individual rise ≥0.5°C (individual criterion)

blocks.zh: 8 隻兔子的最大升溫總和 ≤3.3°C（群體標準）
blocks.en: The sum of the maximum rises of the 8 rabbits ≤3.3°C (group criterion)

blocks.zh: 這意味著即使只有 2 隻兔子超過 0.5°C（滿足個體標準），但如果這 2 隻的升溫幅度極大（例如各升 2.0°C，總和已超過 3.3°C），仍然判定為 FAIL。
blocks.en: This means that even if only 2 rabbits exceed 0.5°C (meeting the individual criterion), if the rises of those 2 are very large (for example, 2.0°C each, so the sum already exceeds 3.3°C), the result is still a FAIL.

blocks.zh: RPT 的固有變異性：不同兔子對同一批樣品的反應可能差異很大。這也是 RPT 被 BET 逐步取代的原因之一 — BET 的定量精度和重現性遠優於活體動物試驗。
blocks.en: Inherent variability of RPT: Different rabbits can respond very differently to the same sample lot. This is one reason RPT is gradually being replaced by BET, whose quantitative precision and reproducibility are far better than those of in vivo animal tests.

blocks.zh: 判定邏輯範例
blocks.en: Decision Logic Examples

blocks.zh: 如果 Stage 1 的 3 隻兔子中有 2 隻升溫超過 0.5°C，Stage 2 追加 5 隻後最多還能有幾隻超標才能通過？
blocks.en: If 2 of the 3 rabbits in Stage 1 show a rise above 0.5°C, after 5 more rabbits are added in Stage 2, how many more can exceed the limit while the test still passes?

blocks.zh: 假設 8 隻兔子中只有 1 隻升溫超過 0.5°C，但那隻升了 3.5°C（其餘 7 隻均為 0），結果是 PASS 還是 FAIL？為什麼？
blocks.en: Suppose that among 8 rabbits only 1 shows a rise above 0.5°C, but that rabbit rose 3.5°C (the other 7 all showed 0). Is the result PASS or FAIL? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼規定「溫度下降視為零」？如果允許計入負值，會對判定結果產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does the text specify that "a temperature decrease is considered zero"? What effect would it have on the determination if negative values were allowed to count?

blocks.zh: 兩階段判定邏輯：
blocks.en: Two-stage decision logic:

blocks.zh: Stage 1: 3 隻兔子
blocks.en: Stage 1: 3 rabbits

blocks.zh: 全部 <0.5°C → PASS
blocks.en: All <0.5°C → PASS
↓ Any ≥0.5°C

blocks.zh: Stage 2: 追加 5 隻（共 8 隻）
blocks.en: Stage 2: 5 additional rabbits (8 in total)

blocks.zh: ≤3 隻 ≥0.5°C 且 8 隻總和 ≤3.3°C → PASS
blocks.en: ≤3 rabbits ≥0.5°C and sum for the 8 rabbits ≤3.3°C → PASS

blocks.zh: ↓ 否則
blocks.en: ↓ Otherwise

blocks.zh: FAIL — 產品判定為含熱原
blocks.en: FAIL - the product is judged to contain pyrogens

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字記憶：
blocks.en: Key numbers to remember:

blocks.zh: 溫度下降 = 零：如果注射後兔子體溫反而下降了（例如從 39.0°C 降到 38.7°C），不能計為 −0.3°C — 必須記為 0°C。這是為了避免陰性讀數「稀釋」其他兔子的陽性反應。
blocks.en: Temperature decrease = zero: If a rabbit's temperature falls after injection (for example, from 39.0°C to 38.7°C), it must not be counted as −0.3°C; it must be recorded as 0°C. This prevents negative readings from "diluting" the positive responses of other rabbits.

blocks.zh: Radioactive Pharmaceuticals — 放射性藥品
blocks.en: Radioactive Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 「保鮮期限」與品質檢驗的衝突：
blocks.en: The conflict between "shelf life" and quality testing:

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家壽司店。新鮮鮪魚從漁港送到店裡只有幾個小時的最佳賞味期。如果你堅持要等實驗室的細菌培養結果（至少 24 小時）才出餐，魚早就不新鮮了。所以你被迫「先出餐、後報告」— 這就是半衰期 <1 天的放射性藥品允許「先放行、36 小時內完成 RPT」的邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a sushi restaurant. Fresh tuna delivered from the fishing port stays at its best for only a few hours. If you insisted on waiting for the laboratory's bacterial culture results (at least 24 hours) before serving, the fish would long since have lost its freshness. So you are forced to "serve first, report later". This is the logic behind allowing radioactive pharmaceuticals with a half-life of <1 day to be "released first, with RPT completed within 36 hours".

blocks.zh: 當然，這也意味著如果事後 RPT 結果不合格，你需要啟動召回程序 — 所以前端的製造控制和環境監測必須極其嚴格。
blocks.en: Of course, this also means that if the RPT result later fails, you need to start a recall procedure, so upstream manufacturing controls and environmental monitoring must be extremely strict.

blocks.zh: CDMO 相關性：大多數無菌充填 CDMO 不直接處理放射性藥品，但這個段落的「先放行後測試」概念在製藥業中並不罕見 — 例如無菌工藝模擬（APS）的培養期、某些生物製劑的加速放行。
blocks.en: CDMO relevance: Most aseptic filling CDMOs do not handle radioactive pharmaceuticals directly, but the "release first, test afterward" concept in this paragraph is not unusual in the pharmaceutical industry, for example the incubation period of an aseptic process simulation (APS) or the accelerated release of some biologics.

blocks.zh: BET 在放射性藥品中的優勢：BET 只需約 1 小時即可得到結果，遠快於 RPT 的 3+ 小時。這也是為什麼大多數放射性藥品現在都改用 BET 做放行測試。
blocks.en: The advantage of BET for radioactive pharmaceuticals: BET gives a result in only about 1 hour, much faster than the 3+ hours of RPT. This is why most radioactive pharmaceuticals now use BET for release testing.

blocks.zh: 半衰期 <1 天的放射性藥品允許先放行再做 RPT。如果 RPT 結果為陽性（不合格），此時藥品可能已經注射到病人體內。你的品質系統應該有什麼應急機制？
blocks.en: Radioactive pharmaceuticals with a half-life of <1 day may be released before RPT is done. If the RPT result is positive (fails), the drug may already have been injected into patients. What contingency mechanisms should your quality system have?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Cold Kits 的劑量計算以 70 kg 人體為基準？如果目標病患族群是兒童（平均 25 kg），這個計算方式是否仍然適用？
blocks.en: Why is the dose calculation for Cold Kits based on a 70 kg human? If the target patient population is children (average 25 kg), does this calculation still apply?

blocks.zh: 放射性藥品的特殊挑戰：放射性藥品（radiopharmaceuticals）有兩個獨特問題：
blocks.en: Special challenges of radioactive pharmaceuticals: Radiopharmaceuticals have two unique problems:

blocks.zh: 劑量限制 — 不能像普通藥品一樣給兔子注射 10 mL/kg，因為過高的放射性劑量會傷害兔子
blocks.en: Dose limit - Rabbits cannot be injected with 10 mL/kg as with ordinary drugs, because an excessive radioactive dose would harm the rabbits

blocks.zh: 時效性 — 短半衰期放射性藥品（如 Tc-99m，半衰期 6 小時）必須在製備後盡快使用，無法等待 RPT 結果出來才放行
blocks.en: Time sensitivity - Short half-life radiopharmaceuticals (such as Tc-99m, half-life 6 hours) must be used as soon as possible after preparation and cannot wait for the RPT result before release

blocks.zh: 劑量計算邏輯：
blocks.en: Dose calculation logic:

blocks.zh: RPT vs BET: The Method Transition — 從兔法到 BET 的方法轉型
blocks.en: RPT vs BET: The Method Transition

blocks.zh: 重點提示：什麼時候還需要 RPT？
blocks.en: Key Point: When Is RPT Still Needed?

blocks.zh: 雖然 BET 已成為主流，但在以下情況中 RPT 仍可能被需要：
blocks.en: Although BET has become the mainstream, RPT may still be needed in the following situations:

blocks.zh: BET 干擾產品 — 某些藥品（如含有 β-glucan 的真菌衍生產品、高蛋白製劑、某些抗凝血劑）會干擾 LAL 試劑，導致假陽性或假陰性。即使嘗試各種稀釋和抑制增強試驗（inhibition/enhancement test），仍無法克服干擾。
blocks.en: Products that interfere with BET - Some drugs (such as fungal-derived products containing β-glucan, high-protein formulations, and certain anticoagulants) interfere with LAL reagent, causing false positives or false negatives. Interference cannot be overcome even after trying various dilutions and inhibition/enhancement tests.

blocks.zh: 檢測非內毒素熱原（NEP） — BET 只能檢測革蘭氏陰性菌的 LPS。如果需要檢測革蘭氏陽性菌、真菌或病毒來源的熱原，RPT 仍是唯一的藥典方法（MAT 正在發展但尚未普及）。
blocks.en: Detection of non-endotoxin pyrogens (NEP) - BET can only detect LPS from Gram-negative bacteria. If pyrogens of Gram-positive bacterial, fungal, or viral origin must be detected, RPT remains the only compendial method (MAT is being developed but is not yet widely adopted).

blocks.zh: 舊有法規要求 — 某些國家/地區的法規或個別產品的 monograph 可能仍明確要求 RPT。
blocks.en: Legacy regulatory requirements - The regulations of some countries/regions, or the monograph of an individual product, may still expressly require RPT.

blocks.zh: 動物福利法規的壓力：歐盟指令 2010/63/EU 明確要求「只要有經驗證的替代方法存在，就不得使用動物試驗」。這在法規層面推動了從 RPT 到 BET/MAT 的轉型。
blocks.en: Pressure from animal welfare regulation: EU Directive 2010/63/EU expressly requires that animal testing must not be used wherever a validated alternative method exists. This has driven the transition from RPT to BET/MAT at the regulatory level.

blocks.zh: 從信鴿到電報到電子郵件：
blocks.en: From carrier pigeon to telegraph to email:

blocks.zh: RPT 就像信鴿 — 最古老但仍然能用的通訊方式。BET (LAL) 就像電報 — 更快更可靠，但仍然依賴特殊資源（鱟血）。rFC（重組因子 C）就像電子郵件 — 完全合成、不依賴任何動物。產業正在從「電報」走向「電子郵件」，但「信鴿」在極少數特殊場景下仍被保留。
blocks.en: RPT is like a carrier pigeon: the oldest communication method that still works. BET (LAL) is like the telegraph: faster and more reliable, but still dependent on a special resource (horseshoe crab blood). rFC (recombinant Factor C) is like email: fully synthetic and independent of any animal. The industry is moving from "telegraph" to "email", but the "carrier pigeon" is still retained in a very small number of special scenarios.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前使用什麼方法做熱原/內毒素放行測試？如果仍在使用 RPT，評估一下轉換到 BET 需要什麼步驟（驗證、法規申報、人員訓練、設備投資）。
blocks.en: What method does your CDMO currently use for pyrogen/endotoxin release testing? If you still use RPT, assess what steps would be needed to switch to BET (validation, regulatory filing, personnel training, equipment investment).

blocks.zh: 一位客戶要求你對其蛋白質藥物同時做 BET 和 RPT — 理由是「BET 有干擾風險」。你會如何回應？需要什麼數據來支持你的建議？
blocks.en: A customer asks you to run both BET and RPT on its protein drug, on the grounds that "BET carries a risk of interference". How would you respond? What data would you need to support your recommendation?

blocks.zh: 從 3Rs 原則的角度，rFC 試驗（完全不使用動物來源材料）相比 LAL 試驗（使用鱟血）有什麼倫理上的優勢？但目前 rFC 面臨哪些法規接受度的挑戰？
blocks.en: From the perspective of the 3Rs principles, what ethical advantages does the rFC test (which uses no animal-derived material) have over the LAL test (which uses horseshoe crab blood)? But what regulatory acceptance challenges does rFC currently face?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: USP⟨151⟩兔熱原試驗（RPT）是最古老的藥典熱原檢測方法，透過監測兔子注射後的體溫上升來判定產品中的熱原含量
blocks.en: USP⟨151⟩ Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT) is the oldest compendial pyrogen test method; it determines the pyrogen content of a product by monitoring the rise in rabbit body temperature after injection

blocks.zh: 器材除熱原要求 250°C × ≥30 min 乾熱處理，溫度探針精度需達 ±0.1°C
blocks.en: Depyrogenation of apparatus requires dry-heat treatment at 250°C × ≥30 min, and temperature probe accuracy must reach ±0.1°C

blocks.zh: 試驗動物管理嚴格要求：sham test 適應訓練、48 小時最小間隔、陽性後 2 週禁用
blocks.en: Test animal management is strictly required: sham test conditioning, a minimum interval of 48 hours, and a 2-week exclusion after a positive result

blocks.zh: 兩階段判定邏輯：3 隻初試 → 全部 <0.5°C 則 PASS；任一 ≥0.5°C 則追加 5 隻 → ≤3/8 隻超標且總和 ≤3.3°C 則 PASS
blocks.en: Two-stage decision logic: initial test with 3 rabbits → PASS if all are <0.5°C; if any is ≥0.5°C, add 5 more rabbits → PASS if ≤3 of 8 exceed the limit and the sum is ≤3.3°C

blocks.zh: 放射性藥品有特殊劑量計算規則，短半衰期產品可先放行後補做 RPT（36 h 內）
blocks.en: Radioactive pharmaceuticals have special dose calculation rules, and short half-life products may be released first with RPT completed afterward (within 36 h)

blocks.zh: 方法轉型趨勢：RPT 正逐步被 USP⟨85⟩BET 取代 — EP 已於 2010 年刪除 RPT。RPT 僅在 BET 干擾產品或需檢測非內毒素熱原時仍有角色
blocks.en: Method transition trend: RPT is gradually being replaced by USP⟨85⟩ BET, and EP deleted RPT in 2010. RPT now has a role only for products that interfere with BET or when non-endotoxin pyrogens must be detected

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略：優先使用 BET 做放行測試，僅在科學合理且法規要求時保留 RPT 能力。持續關注 rFC 和 MAT 等新型體外方法的法規進展
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: Use BET first for release testing, and retain RPT capability only where scientifically justified and required by regulation. Keep following the regulatory progress of newer in vitro methods such as rFC and MAT
